review_description: Very professional installers, and detailed instructions and advice after installation.

I had an old system (comprised of two single phase systems on 3 phase mains power) completely replaced with 20kw of panels, a 15kw 3-phase Sigenergy inverter and 40kwh of battery storage and couldn't be happier. The sales/quote process was excellent, they really took the time to understand my goals and what I needed. The interaction with Energex left a lot to be desired though (and completely out of Halcol's control). Due to weather the installation was completed over 3 days, 2 one week, one the next and the team onsite couldn't have been better. Very professional, happy to have me "hover" and watch what was happening and took the time to explain every question I had. We are now a couple of weeks post that and I couldn't be happier with the process and the fact that discussion and questions about future options and how to optimise what I have now are welcomed openly. I would always recommend getting quotes via Solarquotes, however if you select Halcol I don't believe you will be disappointed with the outcome from this family run business.

>The sales/quoting process was prompt and the Sales Person was very helpful and patient.>The installation went great with the Installers being very friendly and polite, they were exactly on time and they cleaned     up very good upon completion. The installers were awesome!!>The customer service has been great so far, they organised for connection to the grid after the install and I was notified three days later by Energex informing that my connection had been accepted. We are still waiting to connect the battery on July 1st 2025 and that's when they will show me how to use/monitor the system correctly.

The Sales representatives did a great job identifying the strengths of their potential solution - they answered all questions well and their on-site review helped me to gain confidence in their solution.The formal quote was received very quickly after their visit.The installation team arrived on site as planned after a discussion 10 days earlier. They were polite and punctual.The electrician involved went through all the system with me and a subsequent wifi issued was resolved via their technical support at their office.All in all a great experience - thanks Halcol Energy.
Quote process very clearNext steps explained in detailInstallation crew excellent

I made the mistake of trying to lowball our replacement system. After being stuffed around by two other FB solar suppliers, and wasting two months, we decided to go with Halcol as it was a local company.The team at Halcol was very professional and knowledgeable. Josh did a preliminary site visit – no pressure and he knew his stuff.  The system was installed two weeks earlier than originally quoted. Ben and Bryce, the installers, arrived on time, did a very neat installation and were very communicative and professional.We went with all black AIKO panels and they look great. The system works even better than expected and we are happy with all aspects of the deal.So, more than happy to recommend Halcol to anyone looking for a quality system.

The whole process of dealing with Halcol was incredible. Sales and quote process was easy and not pushy at all. The advice was professional and personalised for what we wanted. Installation was quick and tidy. There was good communication of what was happening or when iissues came up. The issues were resolved in a professional and generous manner.

The beginning to end process with Halcol Energy was simple. The salesperson was on time, engaging and answered all questions and queries I had. The installation team were great and equally as professional and informative explaining to me everything that was going on. It was great to be engaged in discussion also about where cuts, holes and duct routing could go rather than just go ahead where they thought was best. The post installation was also great so I was able to understand how to use the new system and get hold of after sales support services. A very good experience with Halcol.
Quoting was easy to understand with discounts applied without requesting!Punctual and efficient install.

Also, Clancy from CDC was a great salesman but quote was $800 more than Halcol. We think we got the best installation company but for a cheaper price. A great marriage with both!Customer service was excellent. They did all the paperwork. We would recommend both these companies to anyone.

Really good sales guy - the only one that spent the time to sit down inside and go through everything. Even came back a second time to go through all of the quotes that I had received and talk through pros and cons of all systems.Installers were really good, communicated throughout the day and minimal interruption to working from home. Install is tidy. Only feedback would be to go through the app in a bit more detail to understand all of its features.Feedback for the solar company is that I haven't had any post install contact from them (it's been just over a week). It would be good to be contacted to make sure everything was installed as expected, is working as expected and also some advice on whether we should look at our electricity bills and consider other providers.

Great job. The 3 young guys were great. All very professional and very polite and kept me well informed.The company was great to deal with and they allowed me time to process the information, they did not hassle me just to get a sale. Hopefully there will be no dramas in the future. But if there are they should be able to sort to them out quickly.Karen
No issues with this process and all provided written quotes.The installation was on time and Neat and tidy.All instructions were done first hand.
From the moment I rang to get my failed system repaired Halcol were fantastic to deal with for a replacement system.
Excellent service all round from start to finish. Very good quoting. Excellent installation. Good follow up.

I used Halcol to install a 13.2 kwh system to our new home. They installed it on the day we moved into our new home, smooth process and friendly staff. Weeks later when we had an issue with less than expected solar generation, it was followed up, discussed and sorted. Knowing when things don't go well that Halcol follow your concerns is comforting. Respected and reliable company to deal with.

I'm happy with Halcol Solar energy for it's the welknown company in our region. After some correspondence and phone calls, I believed this shouldn't be a wrong choice. The job went on very quickly and well organised. The price was what I expected from what I learnt from the SQ. Thank you for your recommendations and initial information before buying.
Great service and good advice. Delivered before expected time and polite.
The quote process was precise. The delivery was timely. Excellent service and installation .

The service was excellent right from the first contact for a quote, ordering and scheduling of the installation. The installation was completed and commissioned within a day by a two man team who did a fantastic job. The installation guys had to do a return visit after I had my wifi connected and installed the app on my phone and were happy to do so, and did an extra check of the system while they were here.I would highly recommend Halcol and their team for their quality of product, customer service, sales and knowledge of Solar and of course their installation.

Very happy with the quote, information and choices I was given prior to making my decision.  They were very understanding and accommodating with the installation date (which needed to be altered due to my decision to paint the roof first).  On the day of installation the electricians were punctual, professional and very friendly.  They ensured my system was connected to the Wifi so I can monitor it via an app and then organised for the grid connection with my energy provider.  I would highly recommend Halcol to anyone thinking of installing solar panels.
Everything went very smoothly, everyone i had contact with were polite and punctual. very happy with the end result

From the first phone call to arrange a quote to final installation the experience was nothing short of delightful.  Odd I know. Every question was answered in plain English and they even answered a few questions I hadn’t even asked. A very pleasant experience. Would highly recommend.  The job was fast and to the highest standards. The on site crew were amazing. Very professional. Again, all questions were answered.   I didn’t have to anything except enjoy my solar. Thank you.

The quoting process was easy and efficient, with quoting for different options not an issue.All queries were answered promptly and professionally.All grid paperwork was taking care of, ensuring no hassles.Installation was done quite quickly with installers turning up as scheduled. They were polite and friendly and professionally answered any questions I had. They confirmed exactly what was being done and catered for any of my requirements, were they could. A quality install was done and cleanup was complete.Removed working equipment was donated to an organization which will redeploy them in non 1st world countries.I can highly recommend Halcol and their 'value for money' hardware offered.

The initial contact with Halcol was highly informative, the whole process was smooth and easy.The install was also smooth and easy the installers were courteous, punctual and really knew their suff.The metre was changed prior to the install and was efficiently arranged by Halcol.
Glad i chose them to install my system as the last installer i had were dodgy and i believe i have a far better system thanks
Excellent and helpful sales representative. Installation on time and great service.
Only one who sent someone to our home to discuss our needs. Showed up on time install day everything went wellOrganized with energy grid connecttion up and running within 14 days.

Had the system installed in Feb, then we had heavy rain off & on. I then noticed that one of the bedrooms had water stains on the ceiling. Rang the company & they are going to send someone out to check where the water is coming through. Found them to be very helpful & understanding in sorting out this out.
Customer service excellentThe installers were there on timeCleaned up after themselvesWe got 3 quotes and Halcol was in the middle

One company just got my details via phone which was not at the same personal level as the other two. The sales person of the company I went with was very informative and friendly with what I viewed as the best system for my situation.The installers were punctual with a good explanation of the installation process and a very tidy completion.They organised the meter replacement and the grid connection in a seamless manner for us.
From the first point of contact to the final installation, Halcol were fantastic. They were very professional, and gave great balanced advice and information.

From quotation to installation really good service. After the installation any problems with the grid connection were promptly resolved. Thank you for your pleasant and efficient customer service. Paul Edward.
Everything from the first talk with Halcol was fantastic! They have a great team both in the office and in the field and would definitely recommend and use again.
Quote was good not the cheapest nor the dearestOnly company to quote on 7.6kW panels and 6 kW inverter. Rest were 6 kW Solar and 5 kW inverter
Halcol sales person was good until contract signed and then appeared to lose some interest. Follow up questions seemed to be low priority.Installer was excellent. Very happy.

Everything went smooth, quick and easy for me!Halcol Energy team was great with everything, guide me through the whole process and very understanding of my needs.Excellent customer service, I have been recommending Halcol Energy to all my friends! I am very, very HAPPY with with this company! Thank you!!!
Halcol are very professional and courteous even ringing to say they would be a little late on the day of installation.
Halcol were great to deal with. Everything went smoothly from start to finish. Friendly and helpful office staff as well. Would highly recommend.

Impressed from the beginning to end with a detailed explanation of the panels, inverter & app .  Sales person was happy to answer all questions with further helpful information. Bring on summer with our new Solar system!!Many thanks
Halcol energy were professional and informative from initial quote to installation.

Quotation process was really well done with no hidden fees. What we were quoted was what we paid. Our sales rep gave us lots of different permutations to think about and gave honest advice and feedback.The installation went really well and was all done in a day. The two guys arrived early and stayed until sundown to get the job finished.We did have to call our installer back the following day as the inverter was installed failing to make use of the dual MPPT on the inverter. We were very impressed with how speedily this was rectified (within the hour!), Although arguably, this shouldn’t have happened in the first place and it was only through hours of research on websites, like solor quotes that I knew it was not properly installed.The biggest disappointment, however, was that my close friend who referred us to Halcol was denied his referral bonus. This is despite me having a full conversation with the sales rep and mentioning it in an email. They refused to pay him his referral bonus. This is why I marked them down for customer service.

We had a great experience from quoting through to install. Sales person was diligent and provided options to suit our needs to help us make an informed decision. And the installation was seamless. We chose to shop local to support the community and could not be more impressed!
The team at Halcol were great to deal with. The solar system they recommended was tailored to our requirements and the installation process was seamless.

Quotung was very impersonal, but once we accepted the quote everything went of like clockwork.Workers arrived on time and were polite and hard working.5 hours later we had solar and were savings dollars.thanks halco

I was unfortunate enough to be trying to build a house during COVID and so had some severe delays, the team at a Halcol were fantastic more than happy to discuss all the options I had for my solar over the time frame and through all the changes. When it came to the install I blinked and missed it they were so quick and efficient. I was also fabulously impressed when they contacted me a few months later to let me know that someone I had referred had purchased and I was eligible for a referral bonus, without any printing from me. I had already given a glowing review and referred someone but as I work in customer experience design I was very very impressed and being proactively contacted to be given money! Well done and thanks again team the system is working brilliantly :-)

The process was efficient and friendly from the start of the meeting to obtain the initial quote. The sales person was helpful and informative and at no time was pushing for us to agree or sign up to anything. They left the quote with us to decide, no constant checking to see if we had decided.The on site install was efficient, professional and completed without any issues. The system operates in line with what we were advised and we are happy with the outcome. They advised our supplier of the install who attended and changed the meters with no problems.I would be happy to recommend Halcol to anyone looking to install a solar system.
All of the above, Excellent! Ease Of dealing with, friendly staff, very good installers, delivered what promised!No complaint.Thank you for referralRegards Klaus Heger
Easy to deal with and we had the installation within a week

Received a prompt sit down and explanation of products available. No big sales push or pressure. Friendly service right through. Installed on a public holiday and had the job done in less than 4hrs. So far we are happy with the quality and performance of the product.

Great company to have install your solar system. From the in home visit to determine what you are after to the multiple quotes for a variety of options across systems/set ups and price points the sales process was faultless.The installation was scheduled promptly. The technicians turned up on time, were very professional and their work was faultless. The installation is very neat, they cleaned everything up and left no mess behind.The guys showed us how the system works, set up all the wifi connectivity and monitoring apps etc.Highly recommend Halcol to anyone looking for a solar install or upgrade in their service area.

First got a quote, to install at end of year when house was ready. When House was ready they could not install and had to get a new quote which was an extra $1,000Then when they did install the system it was put on the wrong roof, however this was fixed immediately

The sales and quoting process was terrific answered all questions asked, on day of installation work crew arrived on time and completed their task diligently, quickly without disturbing the household, even had time to pat the dogs.  The site was left tidy wouldn't know they had been here.
Simple and quick.. reaping the benefits two weeks after making the decision to buy

My system was installed in sept 2021. We were given different quotes on 3 systems in varying prices by the sales assistant. On recommendation by him we went with the more expensive one. I didn’t have much knowledge about solar systemsso I choose the solar edge system as this is what he recommended. Happy with the installation and running of it. We had a hail storm a few months later and needed it replaced under warranty. Again I got a few quotes and was told by the 2 other companies who did the quote, that because we had no shade on our roof we didn’t ever need the system that we were sold. Please be aware of what you are buying and do your research.
From the initial enquiry , right thru to installation every thing was professionally handled.Kept up to date all the way.Would highly recommend

From the pre sales service, right through to the installation we were extremely happy with the service and quality provided by the team at Halcol Energy. We have recommended their services to all our friends.

Installation ok but would have preferred an internal install for the inverter, not in the sun all day, and totally on show. Staff were fine. Connection was fine as well.A 12 mth follow up would be nice, possibly a panel clean as well as part of the service.

From the quote to install all went smoothly. We were kept informed and the information was easy to understand. The installation was quick and efficient, leaving no mess at all. We were provided with all of the information required to set up our system. The app feature is great although mine won’t work (think it’s my phone) my husband has the app working perfectly. I have recommend to others.
Very easy process, happy to adapt to us during our build process!Come back and finished the job promptly running through the system with us. Would happily recommend!
Just recommended you to someone the other day - that says a lot.  Thanks
Had a  great experience with the team from Halcol. From the very start with arranging a quote, right through to the installation process, the whole team were very helpful, Highly recommend.
Halco was fantastic- just took a while for the team to come back and replace the four tiles that got broken during installation but otherwise great team with excellent customer service!
Top installation but doesn't cancel out bill like they said and don't hear from them after they want to have a look at a bill.
From start to finish the sales and installation was great i am so glad i went with the local trusted business.
The process was easy, good communication, prompt installation and instructions. The team at Halcol are great. Highly recommended.

The two installers turned up right on time and ran through all details before commencing to make sure we were happy with the placement of the inverter and configuration of the panels.they used guards on the guttering so the ladders and panels didn’t scratch them.it was a large insulation of 13kw which is 36 panels which was completed and up and running that day.

The whole process with Halcol was excellent. Gary from Sales came to the house and laid out all the information and provided advice on the best system for our needs. The installers were on time, polite, helpful and tidy. Assistance by phone from the office was great. Tech support to get the app working was perfect. All up, a great experience.

The salesman was quick to arrange a visit to quote. Several options discussed. The best system for my needs suggested.  Not the biggest or most expensive but right for my usage and expectations of feed in.

The Sales and quotation process was straightforward and professional. Installation was punctual and friendly. The install team were thorough in their explanation of how the system worked. I also appreciated how they consulted me on the day about the best spot for the inverter to be installed. The install looks great and I’d highly recommend Halcol!

Quote was detailed and easily understood. Received very good advice and recommendations for our solar needs not being familiar with the system. Very good communication during the quote process. Very helpful, polite and knowledgeable. Installation done on time and punctual. Good quality installation.
Everyone is so friendly at Halcol with a seamles process from the quote all the way through to commissioning. Top quality product and service. Wouldn't hesitate recommending them to anyone.
From start to end the process was seemless... Great install... Freindy, clean. Efficient and highly professional... Definitely recommend to friends and family
Great to deal with and I’m very happy with my new system

Sales/quoting process excellent. We are pensioners but the whole process was easy to understand and the no fuss approach led us to decide to go with Halcol. The installation was fantastic, on time and the installers were incredibly friendly and polite. Customer service - 11/10. The head installer was so helpful and explained the installation very thoroughly. Lots of patience and connected us to the grid via our iPad. Only a young man, but a credit to his company.

Pre sale assessment of my needs was detailed and appropriate. Costing was broken down and explained. Rebates were explained and applied in full..The installation was efficient and professional. I am very happy with the system installed.Halcol are quick to return calls and very helpful with questions or concerns. Great customer care.
Everything happened quickly and just as the salesman said it would. Highly recommend.

We couldn’t be happier with the service and system we received from Halcol.They were extremely helpful at the initial stage of arranging the system and discussing the best options for our property.On the day of installation the team who attended were very professional with their conduct and had the system up and functioning as planned.We have been receiving great kw return from the system so far, so hopefully that continues and will keep the bills down or maybe even a credit.
All aspects of purchase and installation were great. Aftersales is fantastic.
Halcol was very friendly and helpful with the Solar Panel quote and installation. They have been reliable and the after install customer service has also been great!
Affable, Affordable, AccessibleHighly recommended, from sales to instal great communication, on time and efficient friendly team.

All good with Halcol. Explanation of solar panels choice of invertors was explained clearly. Transparent pricing structure. Quotation was provided promptly; and the hastle free installation before schedule.The staff is good, polite, punctual, and knowledgable.

The original quotation was easy to understand and facilitated by the use of NearMap software.Once we made a decision to use Halcol as our supplier, the whole process went very smoothly, with installation occurring before we expected..  On the day of the installation I was impressed with how well organised the team were, completing the installation in less than a day, and on a public holiday.The explanation about the inverter and setup for future monitoring was easy to understand.All of the behind the scenes paperwork was dealt with efficiently and the installation of the new meter was only delayed by the tardiness of my electricity provider in getting a contractor on site.I have received my first electricity bill since the installation and the output from the solar panels and inverter have exceeded my expectations.

Simon explained how solar system works  and the process in involved in detail.The contractors came out inspected our roof, replaced tiles which were broken  and installed the legs.They came back after our roof was painted and installed the panels and the inverter.  They were very efficient, polite and tidied up after they finished.  They explained how the system would work in detail.Halcol have followed up on a number of times since the installation to ensure that the system is working and that we have no  queries.We had obtained a number of quotes for installation of our new solar system but decided to go with Halcol as they are a local company and provide follow up system with maintenance and care for the system.  We would have no hesitation in recommending them to anyone who is looking to install a solar system
Install went well and as planned to the day that was arranged
Sales and quoting was fantastic. Instal was clean and efficient very tidy.Organised grid connection100% will see them again for next system

The team from Halcol have been great with regards to the install of our system. From the start with prompt quoting to the install, everything went to plan. The guys kept me informed at every point of the install ensuring I was happy with placement of panels and the inverter. Highly recommend!
Great customer service from quote to installation through to after sales service.
Timely accurate & competitive quote.Excellent installation.System continues to work well.Halcol Energy team really good to deal with.

Initially Halcol displayed a good level of product understanding and professionalism. Their quote was reasonable and they were chosen because of their nearby locality.The timeframe as stipulated was adhered to and the installation was quick and seamless.The installers were very courteous and well mannered and their clean up efforts after completing the job was commendable.

Fantastic from start to finish. Just received my first electricity bill since the install of the new 6.6kW system and the solar credits are ahead of the usage charges on the bill.No more paying for electricity. Thanks Andy & Eve from Halcol.

Professional salesperson, installers were great too - on time, neat work and cleaned up afterwards. More technical information on metwork connectivity and local network access would have been useful but overall happy with the experience.
From the time of the quote to the installation, it was an fast and efficient process. It wasn’t the cheapest quote but it was money well spent and I am happy with the product.

From the first phone call and quote we were kept very well informed. Everything was explained so that we understood the process as it progressed. The installers were there exactly when they said they would be. They were quick and tidy and explained the setup very well. We were told what to do to get our feed in tariff. In a very confusing and vast market we could not fault the team from Halcol. We would highly recommend them to anyone.

We can highly recommend Halcol Energy. The staff are very knowledgeable, friendly and helpful.There was a slight issue after the installation; the customer service we received was outstanding and the team went over and above to rectify the issue. 100% satisfied!

The staff in the office were very friendly and efficient. The installers turned up when they said they would and did a very neat and tidy install. There was a part missing but they ordered it in and finished the install as quickly as possible. The installers were very friendly and efficient also and explained how the system works and how to use the app. Everything was organised - all we had to do was pay the bill.

From initial quote and sales service to final installation we had a great experience. Everything we needed to know to make a decision was explained clearly and we felt extremely confident about proceeding. On installation day the entire process was smooth, efficient and professional. Customer service post installation was also fantastic and we had timely communication re grid connection.
So glad we finally took the step to install solar. We chose Halcol Energy and were happy from the initial consultation and quote with Gary, to the installation with Kestrel.

Great service very helpful,I vent with 10.3kwh Canadian panels and 8.3 kw SMA inverter. They were very professional and everything vent smooth.they do everything themselves no contractors which is better if you do have trouble down the track. I did get about 6 quotes but Halcol came out on top.Many thanks for all your helpErik

We found Halcol to a good company to work with and the sales person and installation team to be prompt and courteous.  They organised the paperwork and application forms and although no fault of theirs connection to the grid has yet to be completed due to Christmas break.

Halcol installed a 10KW system for us in August 2021. The sales and quoting process was pleasant. I spoke to 2 other installation companies as well but Halcol simply offered the best deal. The installation itself was fine, as expected. After the installation I downloaded the inverter app and off we went. I look at the app every day now and use my white goods when I can see that I am exporting to the grid.

Quoting was an easy process and supported with detailed information. No questions raised presented a problem. Halcol was not the cheapest quote but they were local and had a good history behind them. It was also easy to talk directly with the business owner Andy Colley who was informative interested and willing to listen and help if needed.The install was booked and the installers turned up at the nominated time. The total install was completed start to finish by mid-afternoon. I received a detailed tutorial on the system. They also installed Solarman app on my phone and walked me through the functions. Not long after the installers had left I received an email from my electricity supplier Alinta to advise that they had received a request from Halcol to update my meter to a Smart Meter in order to accommodate my newly installed Solar. Now that is service.

Everything with halcol was good.The only thing they didn’t talk to us about was where they installed the inverter.I would not have chosen to put it in the garage, which is where they put it.As for there back up service and any questions we have had, they have been excellent.
Look it’s easyNo pressure at sales levelExcellent serviceProbably the neatest polite Electrician and apprentice I have ever metThe Sunny Boy and 18 Canadian Panels have got us in credit all ready

Halcol Energy met my needs and answered all my questions in a processional manner.  The install was very tidy and clearly a professional job.  They took the time to explain how my inverter operates and invited any follow up questions by telephone if I had any.
The sales from Halcol was very professional.The installation of our solar system was tidy & they arrived on time.
I was keen on another installer until they said they would knock off around $1000 if I got in at end of month so they could get a bonus . Very glad we went with Halco.

From start to finish! Process was fantastic, Gary meet onsite and was very polite. He answered all my questions and knew the products well which I appreciated his honesty and transparency. I got the quote by the afternoon and was offered a deal I couldn’t resist, so I accepted without any hesitation.Ben and the crew greeted me upon arrival and introduced themselves which made me feel valued and confirmed I made the right choice going with Halcol. They were fast, efficient and easy to deal with. The install meet my expectations and Ben explained everything I needed to know. The install was clean, tidy showing great workmanship.The girls in the office were very helpful in providing me with final paperwork.Thank you Halcol for installing my first new solar!
The sales and quoting process was very easy, the installers were polite, tidy, punctual and did a neat job.
No pushie salesman tactics used.Had an issue on install day which was quickly resolved by salesman Greg.Highly recommend halcol energy for your solar install.

The sales rep who initially quoted our system was professional and clearly explained everything. The installers were on time and polite. Customer service has also been excellent. We are very pleased with the product from Halcol.
Arrived on time and did not leave any mess after completing the job.  So far the unit works well and we have actually referred a fiend who has used Halcol Energy for installation.
I found the whole project to be all I wanted. So professional They explained everything from w/o to go.they understood my wishes and carried them out. Couldn't wish for more.

Halcol's sales and quoting process was very good. Gary Higgins was very helpful, accommodating and answered what must have seemed to him like a never-ending stream of questions but he did so with very good knowledge, reasoning and with great efficiency.About two weeks after paying a deposit, Halcol arranged an installation date. There was it would appear a little misunderstanding about the time installation would commence however this was not a significant issue. The two guys who came to install the system, Reece and Callum, were very polite, friendly and helpful and did a great job of removing my old solar system and installing the new one. They even removed a disused satellite dish from my roof that would have created some shade over the panels. They cleaned up extremely well leaving no mess and took my old solar system and satellite dish with them for disposal.Reece connected his phone to the inverter and showed me on an app that the system was working and what it was producing at that moment. The system was commissioned immediately and did not require waiting on Energex or anyone else for it to be up and running and producing electricity.Given the system was installed today, I understand I will receive further information from Halcol in coming days about an app that I will be able to access to monitor my solar system.I am looking forward to much lower if not non-existent electricity bills going forward.Thank you Halcol!
Halcol did a great job coordinating the work and connecting us up. Was a seemless easy install.

We received 6 quotes from different companies, a couple were cheaper and the others were more expensive. We didn't feel pressured at the quoting stage and fully understood what would be best for us and the whole process involved. We were so impressed that we installed solar panels on our 3 investment properties as well as our own home. Invoicing was different to the norm but Customer service was very helpful to our needs and handled the grid connection without input from us. The installation crew were courteous, always on time and left no mess behind. Prior to installation, our energy bill was around $500 per quarter. We have had the system for over 12 months now. Our bills were zero until February this year. Currently they are around $180 per quarter and the reason is that we have had many overcast days this year. Last year, the panels/inverter were averaging 35-40 Kw but even with the overcast days, they are generating around 25Kw per day. Our tenants have reported that their systems are working well also. The flow on from this is that we have kept the same tenants throughout this period plus adding value to those properties.I am glad that we chose Halcol and have no hesitation in recommending this company to anyone who is thinking about installing solar panels.

We built a new house and wanted a good size solar system to cater for the future. We got 4 quotes and after reading "the fine print" especially the warranty Halcol came up on top. We settled for a 9.95Kw of panels and a 7.5Kw inverter as we only have a single phase ( 3 phase costs more to put in but u can then get a bigger system but for 2 people we are happy) The installation was a breeze, they organized it with our builder, pre-wired during construction and finished on completion. We now have free power and credit every month. We have a pool, solar pool heating pump, under floor heating in our bathroom and still free power and a great 10 year on sire warranty.
Reliable service, liaised with our builder for rough in of wiring during framing stage. And as soon as it was built halcol returned to install solar panels.
The whole process ran very smoothly with old system removed. Then another contractor repaired and painted our roof then new installation was carried out without any problems at all. Great job.

Brilliant company to deal with. Very professional with communication & installation. Quotes were spot on & exactly what I was looking for. One stop shop from quote to connection with the grid. Absolutely loving the system.

Good old fashioned service. The installation has been in for 14 months now and consistently working efficiently and reliably. Despite the current low feed in tariffs our bills are still in the positive, so payback is fast.

The initial contract signed with Halcol quoted a price which was based on an STC value of $40.00.When the price of STCs plummeted to $31.00 and then to $27.00, I received a call from Halcol informing me that they could not honour the quote on the contract.I thought I was signing for a fixed quote but the contract states that the price offered was subject to an STC rate of $40.00.My issue with Halcol was that as a supplier they must have been aware of STC trends and volitility and so should have at least advised me of possible changes to the contract price at time of signing. I explained to them that I couldn't understand how any business could operate in such an environment and that the customer should be afforded some protection from sliding STC prices once a contract had been signed.I contacted other companies that I had received quotes from (prior to emailing you) and came to the conclusion that they were suffering the same problem.A price that was acceptable to both Halcol and myself was finally agreed to conditional to installation being completed within 3 weeks.Circuit Alert arrived to install the system. I think they squeezed me in to their work schedule as they had 3 installs on their books for the day. I was generally happy with the job. They returned the next day to complete the cable connection to the inverter,  and attended to few 'tidy up' issues with the solar panel installation on the roof.Energex arrived on 07 June to perform the digital meter change over (EM1000).Just in conclusion, I read a few threads on the reading the digital EM1000 maters, and there appears to be some confusion out there. Although the meter contains multiple registers and can be programmed to read date, time, power consumed (at 4 different shoulder rates) etc, and these can be scrolled through manually, the connection in Queensland to a single phase, single tariff domestic supply will show ONLY a + value for power consumed and a - value power fed into the grid (less daily consumption) and nothing else.A handout is mailed from Energex explaining the forms required a the processes involved in completing the IES connection and it also contains a good description of both the single phase meter (EM1000) and the 3 phase meter (EM1200) and how to read both.....yet there still is some confusion out there.
